title: DeepDiver: Adaptive Web-Search Intensity Scaling via Reinforcement Learning
authors_zh: Wenxuan Shi、Haochen Tan、Chuqiao Kuang、Xiaoguang Li、Hanting Chen、Xiaozhe Ren、Yasheng Wang、Lu Hou、Lifeng Shang
paper_type_zh: 推理数据、搜索或测试时扩展研究
best_for_zh: 需要核查推理轨迹、反馈契约、发布边界和复用风险的读者
one_line: DeepDiver trains 7B policies on WebPuzzle with live-web iterative-RAG GRPO, using answer judgments and a conditional search bonus to study how search depth changes with information demand.
DeepDiver 在 WebPuzzle 上用真实网页的迭代式检索增强生成与 GRPO 训练 7B 策略，以答案评判加条件化搜索奖励研究搜索深度如何随信息需求变化。
why: It makes search queries, retrieved evidence, stopping decisions, and episode rewards relevant rollout data for the rollout/search/test-time trace track, while leaving live-web drift and artifact availability as explicit audit limits.
inclusion_reason: WebPuzzle and DeepDiver expose a concrete live-web trajectory object and a judgment-based RL feedback contract for studying adaptive search intensity.

title: Problem
问题
html: Existing iterative-RAG systems are commonly prompted with fixed search rules or trained and evaluated against relatively clean Wikipedia-style corpora. DeepDiver asks whether a model can instead learn when to search, what to query, and how much additional evidence to gather in a live web environment containing noise, stale pages, and conflicting claims. Its primary data object is an episode: a WebPuzzle question, alternating reasoning and search actions, search queries, retrieved documents, a final answer, and episode-level reward. WebPuzzle supplies 23,684 training questions and a 275-question expert-curated test set across Cross-Page QA, Open Riddle, and Wiki Riddle. This belongs in the rollout/search/test-time trace track because the number and depth of search interactions—and the decision to stop searching—are part of the learned trajectory rather than fixed preprocessing.

现有迭代 RAG 系统往往依赖固定的搜索提示规则，或只在较干净的 Wikipedia 式语料环境中训练和评测。DeepDiver 研究模型能否在包含噪声、过时页面和相互冲突说法的实时网页环境里，学会何时搜索、搜索什么以及还需收集多少证据。其核心数据对象是一条 episode：WebPuzzle 问题、交替出现的推理与搜索动作、搜索查询、检索文档、最终答案和 episode 级奖励。WebPuzzle 包含 23,684 个训练问题及由专家整理的 275 个测试问题，覆盖 Cross-Page QA、Open Riddle 和 Wiki Riddle。它归入 rollout/search/test-time trace track，是因为搜索交互的次数与深度以及停止搜索的决定本身都属于被学习的轨迹，而不是固定预处理。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html: DeepDiver combines a live-web question set with an SFT-to-RL curriculum. The policy alternates reasoning with a search action that emits one to five queries, receives the top two results per query from Bocha or LangSearch, and either continues or emits an answer. During GRPO, Qwen-Turbo judges compare the final answer with a reference answer and checklist: an early loose judge assigns 1–10 and treats scores at least 6 as correct, while a later strict judge takes a two-of-three majority over binary judgments. Format and accuracy rewards are supplemented only when no search-free rollout succeeds but at least one search-enabled rollout does; successful search-enabled rollouts then receive +1.0. This is a judgment-based environmental feedback contract, not a programmatic proof, and the reported benchmark accuracy does not certify every query, document, reasoning step, or reward label.

DeepDiver 将实时网页问题集与从 SFT 到 RL 的课程结合起来。策略在推理与搜索动作之间交替：每轮搜索产生一至五个查询，从 Bocha 或 LangSearch 获取每个查询排名前二的结果，然后决定继续还是输出答案。GRPO 阶段由 Qwen-Turbo 根据参考答案和 checklist 评判最终答案：早期宽松 judge 打 1–10 分，至少 6 分视为正确；后期严格 judge 对三次二元判断取至少两票的多数结果。除格式与准确性奖励外，只有在同组中所有不搜索 rollout 都失败、且至少一个搜索 rollout 成功时，成功的搜索 rollout 才额外获得 +1.0。这是依赖环境与判断模型的反馈契约，不是程序化证明；报告的 benchmark 准确率也不能证明每个查询、文档、推理步骤或奖励标签都正确。

title: Method
方法
html:
WebPuzzle candidates come from Wiki-corpus pages and real-user queries with retrieved webpages from a deployed smart-assistant service. LLMs create open-web Cross-Page QA items by extracting facts from multiple pages and generating an inverted question, answer, and checklist; they create Open Riddle and Wiki Riddle items by selecting entity attributes and obfuscating or generalizing them while retaining the entity as label. An LLM filter removes offensive, politically sensitive, ethically concerning, NSFW, ambiguous, controversial, multiple-choice, boolean, and unsolvable items. DeepSeek-R1 answers each remaining problem four times to assign pass@4-based easy, medium, hard, or outlier tags, and five experts reduce 500 test seeds to 275 items under uniqueness, search necessity, multi-search reasoning, and solvability criteria.

Cold-start SFT distills DeepSeek-R1 responses over 2,000 selected WebPuzzle items, 300 deployed-assistant questions, 2,200 general-reasoning problems, and 1,000 real-user queries concatenated with retrieved documents. A separate 5,000 WebPuzzle items feed RL. Each RL prompt receives 14 rollouts at temperature 0.9; the maximum is seven tool-call rounds, the reported sequence limit is 20k tokens, and retrieved tokens are masked from the policy loss. Training uses one epoch of iterative-RAG GRPO with batch size 32, learning rate 1e-6, and KL coefficient 0.001. The paper discloses prompts and aggregate settings, but no official code, model, dataset package, rollout corpus, retrieval snapshot, or complete rejection log was verified.

WebPuzzle 候选来自 Wiki-corpus 页面，以及已部署智能助手中的真实用户查询和相应检索网页。LLM 从多个开放网页抽取事实，再反向生成问题、答案和 checklist，形成 Cross-Page QA；Open Riddle 与 Wiki Riddle 则由 LLM 选择实体属性并进行模糊化或泛化，同时保留原实体作为标签。LLM 过滤器删除冒犯性、政治敏感、伦理风险、NSFW、歧义、争议、多项选择、布尔判断和不可解条目。DeepSeek-R1 对每个剩余问题作答四次，据 pass@4 划分 easy、medium、hard 或 outlier；五位专家再按答案唯一、必须联网、多次搜索推理和可解性等原则，将 500 个测试种子整理为 275 条。

冷启动 SFT 蒸馏 DeepSeek-R1 的回答，混合 2,000 条 WebPuzzle、300 条已部署助手的真实用户问题、2,200 条通用推理问题和 1,000 条与检索文档拼接的真实用户查询；另有 5,000 条 WebPuzzle 用于 RL。每个 RL 样本以 temperature 0.9 生成 14 条 rollout，最多七轮工具调用，报告的序列上限为 20k tokens，检索文本在策略损失中被 mask。训练采用一轮 iterative-RAG GRPO，batch size 32、学习率 1e-6、KL 系数 0.001。论文公开了提示和汇总配置，但未核验到官方代码、模型、数据包、rollout 语料、检索快照或完整拒绝日志。

title: Evidence
证据
html: The strongest evidence separates model outcomes from data quality. On WebPuzzle, DeepDiver-Qwen2.5-7B reports 37.6 average accuracy over three runs versus 27.9 for its cold-start SFT model and 29.8 for R1-Distill; its average search-call rounds rise to 2.51 from 1.85 and 1.75. DeepDiver-Pangu-7B reports 38.1 versus 30.3 and 30.7. In the reward-schedule analysis, switching from the loose to the strict judge after step 80 is associated with a WebPuzzle increase from 29.1 to 37.6, while continuing the loose judge gives little improvement. On ProxyQA, the Qwen variant reports 32.72%, 9.47 points above R1-Distill. These experiments support the claim that the studied RL recipe changes search behavior and task scores in the reported environment. They do not show that WebPuzzle labels are error-free, that the LLM judge is unbiased, that live results are reproducible, or that an unreleased trajectory corpus is high quality.

最有用的证据需要把模型结果与数据质量分开。在 WebPuzzle 上，DeepDiver-Qwen2.5-7B 三次运行的平均准确率为 37.6，冷启动 SFT 为 27.9，R1-Distill 为 29.8；其平均搜索调用轮数也从 1.85 和 1.75 升至 2.51。DeepDiver-Pangu-7B 报告 38.1，而对应两种基线为 30.3 和 30.7。奖励调度分析中，第 80 步后由宽松 judge 切换到严格 judge，与 WebPuzzle 从 29.1 升至 37.6 同时出现；继续使用宽松 judge 几乎没有提升。在 ProxyQA 上，Qwen 版本报告 32.72%，比 R1-Distill 高 9.47 个百分点。这些实验支持“所研究的 RL 配方会改变报告环境中的搜索行为和任务得分”，但不能证明 WebPuzzle 标签无误、LLM judge 无偏、实时检索可复现，也不能证明未发布的轨迹语料具有高质量。

title: Novelty
新意
html: The paper's direction signal is not GRPO, iterative RAG, distillation, or LLM-as-judge individually. Its specific change is to couple them to WebPuzzle and a live search engine so that search-call allocation is optimized inside the RL episode. Relative to prompted iterative RAG and SFT baselines, the policy can vary whether and how deeply it searches; relative to prior Wiki-based search training, the environment deliberately exposes scattered, noisy, and conflicting open-web evidence. The conditional extra-search reward is an early scaffold rather than a universal reward for more calls: it applies only when search changes a group from no successful search-free rollout to at least one successful search-enabled rollout. The result is reusable as a recipe and trajectory schema even though the authors' term Search Intensity Scaling and higher benchmark scores do not by themselves establish data quality or causality outside the reported setup.

论文的方向性信号并不在于单独提出 GRPO、iterative RAG、蒸馏或 LLM-as-judge，而在于把这些机制与 WebPuzzle 和实时搜索引擎结合，使搜索调用分配进入 RL episode 的优化对象。相对于带提示的 iterative RAG 与 SFT 基线，策略可以改变是否搜索以及搜索多深；相对于以往基于 Wiki 的搜索训练，环境有意暴露分散、含噪且相互冲突的开放网页证据。条件式额外搜索奖励只是早期支架，并非对更多调用一概奖励：只有当同组中无搜索 rollout 全部失败、而至少一个搜索 rollout 成功时才触发。即使作者提出的 Search Intensity Scaling 名称和更高 benchmark 得分不能单独证明数据质量或报告设置之外的因果性，这套方法仍可作为配方与轨迹 schema 复用。

title: Limitations
局限
html: The environment is time-dependent: Bocha and LangSearch rankings, page contents, and availability can change, while no retrieval snapshot or exact per-episode result set was verified. Answer rewards rely on Qwen-Turbo prompts, reference answers, and checklists; loose/strict scheduling can alter both learning and evaluation, and majority judgment is not a correctness proof. Pass@4 difficulty labels inherit DeepSeek-R1 and grader errors. The paper does not disclose decontamination controls, complete source URLs, user-query consent, webpage redistribution rights, or a dataset license. Its own scope is limited to 7B models, 20k-token sequences, and search engines; it reports over-searching even on simple tasks. The stated post-review WebPuzzle release, code, trained models, rollouts, rejected candidates, seeds, and retrieval snapshots were not verified as reusable artifacts. Benchmark improvements must therefore remain separate from claims about provenance, label accuracy, release completeness, or reproducibility.

该环境具有时间依赖性：Bocha 与 LangSearch 的排序、网页内容和可用性都会变化，而未核验到检索快照或逐 episode 的完整结果集。答案奖励依赖 Qwen-Turbo 提示、参考答案和 checklist；宽松/严格调度会同时影响学习与评测，多数投票也不是正确性证明。基于 pass@4 的难度标签会继承 DeepSeek-R1 与 grader 的错误。论文未披露去污染控制、完整来源 URL、用户查询授权、网页再分发权利或数据许可证。论文自身也把范围限定于 7B 模型、20k-token 序列和搜索引擎，并报告简单任务上仍有过度搜索。论文所称待审查后发布的 WebPuzzle，以及代码、训练模型、rollout、被拒候选、随机种子和检索快照，均未核验为可复用 artifact。因此，benchmark 提升必须与数据来源、标签准确性、发布完整性和可复现性声明分开。

title: Usefulness
用途
html: For the rollout/search/test-time trace track, DeepDiver provides a concrete schema for an adaptive web-search episode. A reusable record should preserve the original question and source class; reference answer and checklist; difficulty-tagging attempts and grader outputs; model/checkpoint; every reasoning span, query list, engine, timestamp, retrieved URL/snippet/rank, and action; final answer and stopping reason; loose/strict grader prompt and raw decisions; component rewards; group membership; and GRPO sampling parameters. That structure supports SFT trajectory study, agent-training comparisons, reward/judge audits, search-budget analysis, and evaluation of stopping policies. Reuse is presently methodological rather than artifact-level: without an official dataset, rollout release, license, and retrieval snapshot, a reader can reproduce the design concept but cannot assume the authors' records are available or legally reusable.

对 rollout/search/test-time trace track 而言，DeepDiver 给出了自适应联网搜索 episode 的具体 schema。可复用记录应保存原始问题与来源类别、参考答案与 checklist、难度标注的多次尝试及 grader 输出、模型与 checkpoint、每段推理、查询列表、搜索引擎、时间戳、检索 URL/摘要/排名和动作、最终答案与停止原因、宽松/严格 judge 的提示及原始判断、各项奖励、组内成员关系和 GRPO 采样参数。该结构可用于研究 SFT 轨迹、比较 agent training、审计 reward/judge、分析搜索预算并评估停止策略。目前可复用的是方法而非 artifact：缺少官方数据集、rollout 发布、许可证和检索快照时，读者可以复现设计思想，但不能假定作者记录已经可用或可合法复用。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• WebPuzzle has 23,684 training items and 275 expert-curated test items; only 7,000 WebPuzzle items enter DeepDiver training.
  • The cold-start SFT mixture totals 5,500 items, of which 2,000 are WebPuzzle; a separate 5,000 WebPuzzle items are used for RL.
  • Each RL sample receives 14 rollouts at temperature 0.9, not 14 total rollouts; each rollout permits at most seven tool-call rounds.
  • Qwen-Turbo loose/strict judgments, format reward, and a conditional +1.0 search bonus form the episode feedback; none is a programmatic correctness proof.
  • Verify an official dataset, license, code/model/rollout release, retrieval snapshot, user-query consent, and decontamination record before artifact reuse.

• WebPuzzle 含 23,684 条训练数据和 275 条专家整理的测试数据，但只有 7,000 条 WebPuzzle 进入 DeepDiver 训练。
  • 冷启动 SFT 混合共 5,500 条，其中 2,000 条来自 WebPuzzle；另有 5,000 条 WebPuzzle 单独用于 RL。
  • 每个 RL 样本以 temperature 0.9 生成 14 条 rollout，并非总共只有 14 条；每条 rollout 最多七轮工具调用。
  • episode 反馈由 Qwen-Turbo 宽松/严格判断、格式奖励和条件式 +1.0 搜索奖励组成，均不是程序化正确性证明。
  • artifact 复用前应核验官方数据集与许可证、代码/模型/rollout 发布、检索快照、用户查询授权和去污染记录。
